sourceVerification.basis: Release rcap-d-source-packs-2026-08-12 was downloaded and each pack's own sha256 was confirmed against RCAP_D_SOURCE_PACKS_MANIFEST.json.
sourceVerification.filenameOfHashMatchesDeclaredCanonicalPa: 67 of 67 families that declare a path; 8 declare none

checksRun: official source identity, revision and canonical path against the manifest and the family's source-record
source sha256 agreement across source-record, census, production field map and render receipts, and first-hand against the release packs
census completeness: entry count against declared fieldCount, and widget totals where the two counting conventions differ
canonical values located in the finalized artifact by decoding page content including flattened widget appearances
boundary values located the same way, with absence classified as a fitter refusal only when no fragment of the value is in the widget box
clipping, overflow and vertical placement measured on the value's own runs against its widget rectangle, never on neighbouring printed rules
font floor of 6pt over every located value run
multiline behaviour: line count of a located value against the widget's multiline flag
protected and outside-party fields, by recomputing protectCategoryOf over every census field and by testing whether renderer-added text lands inside any protected widget rectangle
placeholder scan over the visible text of every artifact
page count, page size and page order against the verified source binary
XFA, JavaScript, /AA, Launch, OpenAction, SubmitForm, ImportData and URI, both as a byte scan of an inspectable serialisation and as a structural walk of the loaded document model
official appearance preserved: every printed line of the source located in the corresponding output page
non-filing holds: zero fill artifacts for held families, and a scan of every artifact for unrecorded do-not-file language
currentness and legal-design holds against each family's own source-record
output determinism: recorded sha256 and byte length against the extracted artifact, pinned creation and modification dates, and a double render through D0's finalizeOfficialForm on seven families

determinism.pinnedTimestamps: every artifact carrying a date entry uses D:20260101000000Z; no /ID array and no /Producer string is written
determinism.d0DoubleRender: finalizeOfficialForm run twice against the verified source for AL:c-10, NC:aoc-cr-288, VA:cc-1203, NE:cc-6-12, NJ:cn-10557, MO:cr375 and TX:tx-gc-411-0725 produced byte-identical output in all seven cases
determinism.caveat: Lane output cannot be reproduced from D0 alone because each lane adds its own refusal gates on top; what is verified here is that the factory is deterministic and that every recorded hash matches the artifact actually shipped.

limits: Legal sufficiency, venue rules and statutory fit are outside this review; every family in the shard remains under its recorded legal-design and currentness holds.
MO CR-145 falls outside shard 1 and was not assessed.

Boundary-fixture absences were classified as fitter refusals when the widget box holds no fragment of the value; the lanes' own refusal records were read but the refusal was decided from the artifact.

d0SharedFactoryDefects.statement: The contact sheet is built from the raw blank source bytes and is never sanitised, rebuilt or scanned, so it ships the official form's JavaScript, additional-action dictionaries and URI actions inside its own file.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.mechanism: buildContactSheet embeds both panels with sheet.embedPdf(blankBytes|finalizedBytes, [i]). Embedding a page copies the objects reachable from that page, including its /Annots widget array, each widget's /AA dictionary and the /S /JavaScript action objects those reference. The function then calls sheet.save() directly: it applies neither sanitizeAndFlatten nor the copyPages rebuild that leaves orphaned objects behind for the finalized fixtures, and it runs no scanBytesForActiveContent before writing. Because save() defaults to object streams, the residue is compressed, so even a caller that did scan the stored sheet would get {inspectable: false} rather than a verdict.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.evidenceOfConfirmation: 19 of the 43 contact sheets in this shard carry residue markers. For NC:aoc-cr-288-form-en the stored sheet was proved to contain them without any re-serialisation: 6 of its 268 FlateDecode streams inflate to object-stream payloads holding '/AA << /F 82 0 R /K 83 0 R >>' and '/JS (AFDate_FormatEx("mm/dd/yyyy");) /S /JavaScript'. The NJ:cn-10557-en sheet carries 3,419 widget annotations copied from its 18-page source.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.acceptanceCondition: Both panels are embedded from sanitised, flattened, rebuilt bytes; the sheet is serialised so a byte scan can inspect it; buildContactSheet refuses to return a sheet whose scan is not {hits: [], inspectable: true}; and every lane's active-content report covers the sheet as well as the fixtures.

d0SharedFactoryDefects.statement: form.flatten() is called over every field, so pushbuttons, dropdown captions and instructional helper fields are painted permanently onto the page that would be filed.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.mechanism: sanitizeAndFlatten calls form.updateFieldAppearances() then form.flatten() with no field-class exclusion. pdf-lib's flatten draws each widget's appearance stream into page content, so a control that exists only to be clicked, and guidance that the source only ever shows interactively, both become printed matter.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.evidenceOfConfirmation: NH:nhjb-2311 (source pushbuttons 'Clear Form - multi', 'Save and lock form', 'top page', '1st page') and NH:nhjb-3057 ship filings displaying bordered grey 'Clear Form', 'Lock & Save Form' and 'Top of Page' buttons; VA:cc-1203 and VA:cc-1473 (source pushbutton 'ResetButton') ship filings displaying a 'Clear All Data' button. NE:cc-6-12 and NE:cc-6-15-1 ship captions where '(Enter the type of court)' at y=665.9 collides with 'Choose the court' at y=663.5 at 8pt. NH:nhjb-2311 additionally paints 'Enter /s/ before name' inside signature widget sig.8, which carries no /V in the source. All strings are absent from the source's page content and present in the fixtures, including the negative render.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.acceptanceCondition: Pushbutton widgets are removed before flattening; a field whose value is the form's own parenthetical guidance is not painted; no two runs overlap in any finalized artifact; and the negative fixture adds no text to the source page content.

d0SharedFactoryDefects.statement: The attorney protect rule matches only the spelled-out words, so the abbreviation the AOC forms actually use is writable.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.mechanism: The pattern is /\battorney\b|\bcounsel\b|\besq\b|law\s*firm|bar\s*(no|num|number)/. haystack('NameAtty') is 'name atty || nameatty', which it does not match, so protectCategoryOf returns null and the field falls through to the participant descriptors.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.evidenceOfConfirmation: NC:aoc-cr-288-form-en writes the petitioner's name, city, state and ZIP into NameAtty, CityAtty, StateAtty and ZipCodeAtty under the printed heading "Name And Address Of Petitioner's Attorney For Expunction Petition". Rendering D0's own finalizeOfficialForm against the verified source binary reproduces the bind: D0 alone writes 17 fields for this family including the four Atty fields. StAddrAtty and MailAddrAtty escaped only because no participant descriptor happened to match their names, not because a rule refused them.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.acceptanceCondition: protectCategoryOf returns 'attorney' for 'NameAtty', 'CityAtty', 'StateAtty', 'ZipCodeAtty', 'StAddrAtty', 'MailAddrAtty' and equivalent abbreviations, and the four fields are blank in every NC:aoc-cr-288 fixture.

d0SharedFactoryDefects.statement: The full_legal_name descriptor matches /petitioner/, so a narrative field on the court's side of a combined petition-and-order form binds a name.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.mechanism: The descriptor's pattern includes 'petitioner'. A field named PetitionerIsEligibleBecauseText1 therefore resolves to participant.full_legal_name. The CAPTION_FACTS gate that would have refused it applies only when the whole document is classified captionOnly, which a combined petition/order form is not.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.evidenceOfConfirmation: NC:aoc-cr-288-form-en page 2 shows the petitioner's name written on both rules of FINDINGS OF FACT item 5, so the order reads that the reason the petitioner is not eligible is their own name, while the is/is-not election checkboxes above remain blank.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.owner: D0 shared factory, with the lane's document classification as the proximate cause
d0SharedFactoryDefects.acceptanceCondition: A narrative or decretal field is never satisfied by a name descriptor, and caption-only discipline is applied to the pages a court completes rather than to the document as a whole.

d0SharedFactoryDefects.statement: requiresExplicitMapping guards the dates of the criminal event but not its locality, so a venue county can be asserted as the county of arrest.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.mechanism: arrest_date, offense_date, conviction_date, disposition_date and charge all carry requiresExplicitMapping on the stated ground that a wrong value misstates the record to a court. matter.county carries no such guard, and its /\bcounty\b/ pattern fires on any field whose name contains 'county'.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.evidenceOfConfirmation: MO:cr300-source-gated-petition-en binds 'County Where Arrest Occurred' to matter.county with explicitMappings {}, and the value is present in that field's rectangle in both fixtures.
d0SharedFactoryDefects.acceptanceCondition: A field naming the locality of an arrest, offence or conviction binds only from a fact describing that event, and is otherwise refused.

laneReportedClaims.detail: Loading the verified source binary with pdf-lib fails with 'Expected instance of PDFDict, but got instance of undefined', the same message the lane recorded as a blocker. The family produced no census, no classification and no fill, and the manifest carries the matching hold 'binary_not_traversable_no_fixture_fill'. The other TX GC-411 families in this shard (0725 and 0727) render and open normally, so the failure is specific to that binary, not to page access across the GC-411 set.
laneReportedClaims.disposition: held_on_source_or_design is correct; nothing to fix in the lane

laneReportedClaims.verdict: confirmed as a deliberate hold, not a defect
laneReportedClaims.detail: The family produced no fill artifacts at all. reports/findings.json records 'flat_form_anchors_withheld_after_review': every measurable rule either carries no allowlisted descriptor or sits in a block whose subject differs from the descriptor matching its label, so the lane withheld the overlay rather than place a correct value in the wrong statement. That is the right outcome for the risk described.

laneReportedClaims.detail: All five WA families in this shard produced zero PDFs and carry statuses that name the anchor problem directly (overlay_labels_measured_write_box_pending_review, overlay_no_extractable_text_layer, overlay_no_participant_label_matched). There is no artifact to inspect and nothing was shipped, so the anchor problem is a build outcome rather than a defect in a released artifact.

laneReportedClaims.scopeInShard: NC:aoc-cr-288-instructions-es and NC:aoc-cv-226-support-vi are the only non-filing holds in this shard
laneReportedClaims.detail: Both held families carry a fully populated nonFilingNotice object ({notice, page, decodeBasis, cmapsConsulted, matched}) recording the 'NOTE: THIS FORM IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. DO NOT COMPLETE THIS FORM F...' text read off the source's own face, both produced zero fill artifacts, and the manifest carries the notice for both. Scanning every finalized artifact and contact sheet in the shard for do-not-file language surfaced no unrecorded face notice. Nothing in this shard exhibits the reported failure.
laneReportedClaims.disposition: no finding raised; see the evidence-naming finding below, which is a real and separate problem

laneReportedClaims.claim: UTF-8 scan issue in the shared verifier
laneReportedClaims.detail: scanBytesForActiveContent decodes as latin1 and blanks every stream payload before matching, which is what makes a byte scan safe over compressed image data. Running it over all 144 artifacts produced no marker hit on any finalized fixture, and every hit it did produce (19 contact sheets) was independently corroborated by inflating the stored object streams and reading the dictionaries verbatim. No false positive and no encoding-driven miss was observed.
MO:cr-145 does not fall in shard 1 under sha256(familyId) mod 3. Not assessed here.

evidenceConsistencyFindings.statement: The non-filing hold is recorded under four incompatible conventions across the seven lanes, and 19 of the 75 families in this shard record no such field at all.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.detail: D1A writes nonFilingNotice (null or object) plus a boolean nonFilingHoldEnforced; D1B, D1C and D2A write nonFilingNotice only; D3A writes nonFilingNoticeOnFace; D2B and D3B write neither. The manifest exposes a single nonFilingNotice key, so an importer reading it gets undefined for every D3A family and has no field to read at all for D2B and D3B, which together are 39 of the 75 families in this shard. Where the notice exists it is an object in D1B and null everywhere else, so the field is not even consistently typed.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.verifiedNoConcreteMissInThisShard: Every D3A, D2B and D3B source-record in this shard holds a null or absent notice, and a scan of every finalized artifact and contact sheet for do-not-file language surfaced nothing unrecorded. The defect is in the contract, not yet in the data.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.acceptanceCondition: One field name and one shape for the non-filing hold across all lanes, populated for every family, with the manifest builder reading exactly that field.

evidenceConsistencyFindings.statement: legalDesign takes seven distinct spellings across seven lanes, and 25 of the 75 families in this shard record 'unrecorded'.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.detail: D1A: state_legal_design_review_missing_from_supplied_corpus_release_blocker (11). D1B: unrecorded (10). D1C: 'legal_review_requires_track-level import mapping' (8). D2A: legal_review_mapping_status_see_state_legal_review (7). D2B: 'legal_review_mapping:requires_track-level import mapping' (8). D3A: state_legal_review_missing_from_supplied_corpus (5) and unrecorded (15). D3B: legal_review_mapping_requires_track_level_import_mapping (11). Three of these differ only in punctuation and word order. Legal-design review is a stated blocker for approved_for_live, so a gate keyed on this field cannot enumerate its own inputs, and a third of the shard carries no status at all.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.acceptanceCondition: A closed vocabulary for legalDesign, used identically by every lane, with no family recorded as 'unrecorded'.

evidenceConsistencyFindings.statement: The same evidence file carries different shapes and different key names depending on which lane wrote it.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.detail: reports/populated-fields.json is a bare array in D1A, D1B, D2A, D2B and D3A; an object {schemaVersion, basis, count, fields} in D3B; and an object {schemaVersion, canonicalWritten, boundaryWritten, expectedValues} in D1C. Eleven D3A families omit it entirely. reports/overflow-and-clipping.json has seven distinct top-level shapes, one per lane. The contact-sheet proof lives at contact-sheet/contact-sheet-proof.json for 30 families and reports/contact-sheet-proof.json for 19. The census records its provenance under censusBasis in six lanes and under basis in D3B. A consumer written against any one lane silently reads nothing from the others.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.acceptanceCondition: One schema per evidence file across all lanes, with a schemaVersion that changes when the shape changes.

evidenceConsistencyFindings.statement: The manifest records no active-content result for 13 families that shipped a fill and no protected-field scan result for 4 of them.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.detail: activeContentResidue is null for FL:fl-4th-judicial-circuit-duval-county-en, IA:rule-2-86-form-4, LA:la-ccrp-art-999-1-en, NJ:cn-10557-en, NM:nm-4-952-en, NM:nm-4-956-en, NM:nm-local-conviction-order-en, OR (both families), UT:1002ex, UT:1020ex, UT:1022ex and UT:1305ge. protectedFieldScanPass is null for LA:la-ccrp-art-999-1-en and the three NM families, which have reports/protected-fields.json (the policy list) but no reports/protected-fields-scan.json (the read-back from the rendered artifact). The four are anchor-placed overlays, where a read-back matters more than on an AcroForm, not less. This reviewer scanned all of them directly and found their finalized fixtures clean, so the artifacts are sound; it is the recorded evidence that is absent.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.acceptanceCondition: Every family that ships a fill records a protected-field read-back and an active-content scan, and the manifest carries both.

evidenceConsistencyFindings.statement: Eight D1C families carry sourceCanonicalPath: null in both the manifest and their own source-record.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.detail: NE:cc-6-11-2a-instructions-en, NE:cc-6-12-form-en, NE:cc-6-15-1-form-en, NE:dc-6-7-1a-instructions-en, VT:200-00131-form-en, WI:cr-266-form-en, WI:dj-le-247-support-en and WI:dj-le-250b-support-en identify their source only by hash. All eight hashes were resolved against the release packs by this reviewer, so the sources are real and correct, but nothing in the shipped evidence says which file each one is.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.acceptanceCondition: Every family records the canonical bundle path of its source alongside the hash.

evidenceConsistencyFindings.statement: NJ:cn-10557-en records fieldCount 179 against declaredFieldCount 269 with no explanatory note, where other lanes explain the same convention difference.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.detail: D1A writes fieldCountBasis and D1C writes declaredFieldCountNote explaining that the manifest counts widgets while pdf-lib counts terminal named fields. D2B writes neither, so a 90-field gap reads as missing coverage. Summing the widgets across the 179 census entries gives exactly 269, so the census is complete and the mismatch is the convention; only the explanation is missing.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.acceptanceCondition: Any census whose observed count differs from the declared count records why.

evidenceConsistencyFindings.statement: Three different fixture identities are in use, while the D1A lane's own comment states the fact set is shared so that a reviewer comparing two states is comparing renders rather than fixtures.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.detail: D1A, D1B, D1C, D2A and D2B use 'Jordan Avery Reyes'; D3A generates per-state fixtures around 'Marion T. Ellsworth'; D3B uses 'Jordan A. Reyes'. Boundary sets diverge correspondingly. This does not affect any filed artifact, but it does defeat the stated purpose of a shared corpus, and a reviewer comparing a D1 render against a D3 render is comparing fixtures as well as renders.
evidenceConsistencyFindings.acceptanceCondition: Either one fixture corpus across all lanes, or the comment is corrected to describe what is actually done.

findings.fieldOrRegion: orphaned objects carried in from the blank source's AcroForm
findings.visibleDefect: The contact sheet carries active-content residue from the unsanitised blank source: document_javascript, field_javascript, additional_actions. buildContactSheet embeds the raw blank bytes with sheet.embedPdf(blankBytes, [i]), which copies the source page's /Annots widgets and everything they reference, including /AA additional-action dictionaries and /S /JavaScript action objects. The sheet is then written with sheet.save() without sanitizeAndFlatten, without the rebuild-from-flattened-pages step that makes the finalized fixtures clean, and without any residue scan. The markers survive inside compressed object streams, so scanBytesForActiveContent on the stored bytes returns inspectable:false rather than a clean verdict; they are only visible after re-serialising with useObjectStreams:false. The finalized fixtures for this family are clean; only the review artifact is affected.

findings.likelyOwner: D0 scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-contact-sheet.mjs buildContactSheet; every lane inherited it unchanged (all seven lane heads carry byte-identical copies of the D0 shared modules) and no lane's active-content report scans the sheet.
findings.acceptanceCondition: The contact sheet is built from sanitised, flattened, rebuilt page bytes for both panels, is serialised so a byte scan can inspect it, and scanBytesForActiveContent returns {hits: [], inspectable: true} on the stored sheet before it is written.

findings.fieldOrRegion: 'County Where Arrest Occurred' (rect 39.79,275.79 269.95x13.62)
findings.visibleDefect: The field is bound to matter.county, the venue county, and the finalized petition therefore asserts to a Missouri court that the arrest occurred in the filing county. The fact set supplies no arrest locality at all, and production-field-map.json records explicitMappings {} for this family, so nothing authorised the assertion.

Surfaced by the D3A lane.
findings.acceptanceCondition: A field naming the locality of the arrest, offence or conviction binds only from a fact that describes that event (or is refused), and never from matter.county; 'County Where Arrest Occurred' is blank in both fixtures until such a fact exists.

findings.fieldOrRegion: NameAtty (rect 317,632 278x13), CityAtty (317,594 196x13), StateAtty (513,594 23x13), ZipCodeAtty (535,594 59x13)
findings.visibleDefect: The block printed 'Name And Address Of Petitioner's Attorney For Expunction Petition' is filled with the petitioner's own identity. The finalized page shows 'Jordan Avery Reyes' on the attorney name rule and 'Springfield  XX  01234' on the attorney city/state/zip rules. A filed AOC-CR-288 would therefore name the petitioner as their own attorney of record.
findings.evidence: Text decoded from the flattened widget appearances inside each widget rectangle; confirmed by rasterising page 1 of the canonical fixture.
findings.likelyOwner: D1B lane (binding decision) with a contributing D0 defect in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-field-semantics.mjs: PROTECT_RULES['attorney'] is /\battorney\b|\bcounsel\b|\besq\b|law\s*firm|bar\s*(no|num|number)/ and does not match the abbreviation 'Atty', so protectCategoryOf('NameAtty') returns null.
findings.acceptanceCondition: NameAtty, StAddrAtty, MailAddrAtty, CityAtty, StateAtty and ZipCodeAtty are refused with category 'attorney' and are blank in both fixtures, and the D0 attorney protect rule matches the 'Atty'/'Attys' abbreviation so no other AOC form can bind them.

findings.fieldOrRegion: PetitionerIsEligibleBecauseText1 (rect 71,674 519x15) and PetitionerIsEligibleBecauseText2 (rect 71,660 519x15), the two rules under FINDINGS OF FACT item 5
findings.visibleDefect: AOC-CR-288 is a combined petition and order. Item 5 of the court's FINDINGS OF FACT reads 'Petitioner [ ] is [ ] is not eligible for an expunction of the offense(s) listed on Side One. If not eligible, it is because:' followed by two blank rules. Both rules are filled with the petitioner's name, so the order reads that the reason the petitioner is not eligible is 'Jordan Avery Reyes'.
